## Det sorte bælte i emballage
Vi indrømmer gerne, at vi er lidt nørdede, når det kommer til emballage. Vi har tilegnet os viden og know-how igennem rigtig mange år, og det kommer dagligt til udtryk igennem seriøs og gennemtænkt rådgivning. Og vi deler rigtig gerne vores viden med dig, så følg med i vores videnscenter, hvor vi løbende udgiver cases, artikler og guides.
Gå til videnscenteret
## Menneskerne bag
Især på et område er vi ret unikke, MC emballage er nemlig 100% medarbejderejet. Vores særlige ejerskab giver dyb medarbejderinvolvering og vi går gerne den ekstra mil for kunden. Her kan du møde vores fantastiske medarbejdere, som tilsammen udgør MC emballage, og her deler de også lidt ud om sig selv.
Mød holdet
## Fandt du det, du mangler?
Vores lager tæt ved Århus rummer mere end 3.000 artikler som vi tilbyder dag-til-dag levering på. Men udover det har vi mere end 15.000 aktive artikler, hvilket siger lidt om bredden i vores sortiment og vores evne til at dække ethvert behov. Har du ikke fundet det, du mangler i vores standardsortiment, så lad dig inspirere på vores sider om specialvarer.
Specialvarer
## Find emballage til din virksomhed hos MC emballage
Hos MC emballage har vi emballage til både stort og småt, så du kan sende alle slags varer til dine kunder og være helt sikker på, at de når uskadt frem. Vores priser er altid konkurrencedygtige og vores sortiment omfatter blandt andet varer som:
- Papkasser
- Paprør
- Kassefyld
- Indpakningspapir
- Boblekuverter
Vi sælger billig emballage af højeste kvalitet, som kan modstå bump på vejen - også hvis transporten er lang. Med den rette emballage fra MC emballage kan forsendelser nå trygt og sikkert frem, så du og din virksomhed er sikret glade kunder.
MC emballage blev grundlagt i 1988, og i 2013 gik vi i luften med vores onlineshop, som fik navnet Emballage-shoppen. Onlineshoppen gav dengang kunder adgang til vores standard sortiment. I 2021 valgte vi at samle det hele under ét site under navnet MC emballage. Vi har fastholdt alle de gode shoppefunktioner fra Emballage-shoppen, men vi har krydret det med nye og stærke features som vores videnscenter, hvor vi løbende lægger blogindlæg op.
## Hos MC emballage tager vi den grønne dagsorden alvorligt
Vi ønsker ikke kun at tilbyde funktionel og billig emballage hos MC emballage. Vi ønsker også at tage ansvar for at gøre emballageindustrien grønnere og hjælpe virksomheder med at miljøoptimere forsyningskæden. Efter mange år i emballagebranchen ved vi hvad der skal gøres, når virksomheder ønsker at træffe bæredygtige valg.
Vi sørger for at holde os ajour med nye tendenser og udviklingen indenfor bæredygtighed, så vi kan guide vores kunder bedst muligt om miljøvenlig emballage. Vi kan give dig gode råd og vejledning, hvis du og dit firma ønsker at blive en del af den grønne dagsorden. Og vejledning ér vigtigt, da vores produkter ikke altid kan deles op i en bæredygtig og en ikke-bæredygtig kategori. Det afhænger af brugen af produkterne, og hvilken sammenhæng de indgår i.
Vi ser som oftest på de fire begreber “erstat”, “minimer”, “genbrug” og “brug igen”, når vi gennemgår en kundes værdikæde. På den måde finder vi den bedste emballage til den pågældende virksomhed samtidig med, at vi inkluderer gode principper om bæredygtighed.
Når vi gennemgår de fire begreber, så kigger vi blandt andet på, om emballagen kan erstattes af andre mindre miljøbelastende materialer, eller måske helt undværes. Vi overvejer om den nuværende emballage er passende, eller om der overemballeres. Vi undersøger om kundens emballage egner sig til genbrug eller genanvendelse, og til slut ser vi på, om emballagen kan anvendes flere gange eller eventuelt kan erstattes med emballagetyper, som kan genanvendes.
## Ydre emballage til alle formål
Vi ved, at den rigtige papkasse er det første og vigtigste skridt på vejen til den bedst mulige indpakning. Papkasser er den foretrukne emballage til forsendelse over hele verden, da de er billige, genbrugelige, holdbare og håndterbare. Vi har flere forskellige typer papkasser at vælge imellem i mange forskellige størrelser. Uanset hvad der skal sendes, så findes der en papkasse til alle behov. Vi har blandt andet følgende papkasser på lager:
- Foldekasser
- Postæsker
- Konfektionsæsker
- Krydspack-kasser
- Paprør og -tubes
Foldekasserne er standardpapkasser, og hos MC emballage findes de i mange størrelser og med både ét og to lag bølgepap. Postæsker er til mindre forsendelser, som kan suppleres med løse skumindlæg, hvis varerne er skrøbelige. Konfektionsæskerne er velegnede til lette tekstiler, og krydspack-kasserne er gode til forsendelser, som skal indeholde flere produkter. Paprør- og tubes bruges til produkter, der helst ikke må foldes. Denne type beholder kan med fordel benyttes til at sende plakater eller dokumenter.
Hvis forsendelsen har brug for et ekstra beskyttende lag, så sælger vi også bølgepap både med og uden klæb. Bølgepap er et meget fleksibelt materiale og dermed nemt at vikle om varer, som kræver en ekstra god beskyttelse. Vi kan også levere flyttekasser med blandt andet firmalogo påtrykt, hvis det ønskes. MC emballage kan hjælpe dig med det meste.
## Indre emballage og støddæmpende fyld
En god og holdbar papkasse er ikke altid nok, hvis forsendelsen er skrøbelig. Med indre emballage undgås skader og dermed utilfredse kunder. Vi tilbyder flere forskellige former for pakkefyld, der både fikserer og beskytter varerne, så de kan nå frem til modtageren uden tryk eller buler. Vi har blandt andet pakkechips af genbrugspolystyren, som er lige dele støddæmpende og økonomivenligt. Materialet er ressourcebesparende, let og antistatisk. Vores sortiment af beskyttende fyld dækker for eksempel også over:
- Boblefolie
- Luftpuder
- Papirfyld
- Træuld
Boblefolie er stødabsorberende og fleksibelt, og beskytter både mod tryk og snavs. Materialet er utroligt holdbart og egner sig godt til at beskytte varer under transport eller opbevaring. Luftpuder og papirfyld bruges til at fylde papkasser op, så materialerne kan omsvøbe, fiksere og beskytte et produkt. Træuld fungerer blandt andet godt som fyld i gaveæsker, hvor det ser flot og dekorativt ud. Derudover beskytter materialet også ved forsendelse.
En forsendelse beskyttes bedst muligt ved at sikre, at varerne ikke kan bevæge sig rundt i kassen. Det er derfor vigtigt at benytte en passende ydre kasse samt tilstrækkeligt med foringsmateriale, så indholdet netop er fikseret under transporten. Hvis forsendelsen indeholder særligt sårbare genstande som elektronik eller glas, er det også meget vigtigt at pakke hver enkelt genstand separat ind. Således undgås det, at genstandene kommer i direkte kontakt med hinanden, hvor de kan blive ridset eller på anden måde ødelagt.
Hvis det er svært at gennemskue hvilken type emballage, der passer bedst til dine forsendelser, så kan du læse vores guide, som forklarer hvilke former for indre emballage, der fungerer optimalt til diverse forsendelser. Med guiden kan du blive meget klogere på de forskellige materialers funktioner og fordele.
## Øvrige emballagevarer til forsendelser
Hos MC emballage har vi også meget andet smart udstyr til forsendelse og indpakning. Vi tilbyder alt fra plastfolie til forskellige typer strapbånd til forsegling. Derudover har vi værktøj til pakkeprocessen, og vi har endda paller, som du kan stable din emballage på, så du nemt og bekvemt kan opbevare det hele på lageret.
Hvis forsendelsen skal være ekstra fin, så tilbyder vi også alverdens produkter til gaveindpakning. Vi har blandt andet:
- Gaveposer
- Cellofan
- Silkepapir i alle regnbuens farver
Med emballageprodukter fra MC emballage kan dine forsendelser både være praktisk indpakket og godt beskyttet samtidig med, at dine varer er flot pakket ind og præsenteres flot. Med den rette beskyttende emballage kan du sikre glade kunder, hvor leverancen når uskadt frem.
## Køb paller til at transportere varer på
Vi sælger også forskellige typer af paller hos MC emballage, som er ideelle til at fragte mange og tunge varer på samme tid. Vi tilbyder blandt andet EUR-paller, engangspaller og plastpaller, så vores kunder kan finde den variant, som dækker deres behov bedst.
EUR-paller, også kaldet europaller, er både en effektiv og bæredygtig variant. Denne type palle er udviklet til at kunne bruges igen og igen, og den har derfor en stabil opbygning. Pallerne er altså gode til tungt gods. EUR-paller er en del af et retursystem, og derfor er der pant på denne variant.
Plastikpaller har ligeledes mange praktiske egenskaber. Der kan ikke gå utøj i denne type palle og modsat træ, så suger paller i plastik ikke vand til sig, hvilket gør, at vægten på pallen aldrig ændrer sig. Flere og flere lande foretrækker faktisk brugen af plastpaller fremfor paller i træ.
Når en større mængde varer skal fragtes, så er paller uundværlige. Pallen løftes ved hjælp af en truck eller en palleløfter, og på den måde er det muligt at flytte flere hundrede kilo hurtigt og nemt. Fragten kan gøres endnu nemmere ved brug af blandt andet strækfilm, da denne type emballage samler varerne og forhindrer dem i at falde af pallen, så de går i stykker.
## Hvad er emballage?
Emballage er essentielt set indpakningsmateriale som gerne kan omslutte et helt produkt eller emne. Emballage har flere formål, da det kan bruges til transport, opbevaring, beskyttelse, branding og markedsføring. Emballage kan benyttes til transport og opbevaring af en lang række materialer, hvorfor produktionsvirksomheder oftest er de største forbrugere af transportemballage. Emballage er typisk produceret af materialer som bølgepap, papir, folie og træ. Kendte eksempler på transportemballage er papkasser, bobleplast, pakketape, strækfilm, poser og kassefyld.
## Hvad betyder emballage?
Ordet emballage betyder i sin enkeltes forstand ”indpakningsmateriale” eller indpakning til forsendelse. Oftest når man omtaler og arbejder med emballage, så er det med den hensigt at afsende et emne som skal emballeres. Man benytter også ordet emballage om den indpakning forbrugsprodukter er pakket i, hvorfor emballage ikke altid har hensigten om transport.
## Hvad betyder intakt emballage?
Intakt emballage betyder, at emballagen skal være ubrudt. Man forbinder ofte intakt emballage med fortrydelsesret og returret, da nogle produkter mister værdien ved brud af emballage, og dermed i nogle tilfælde frafalder returretten. Dine rettigheder som forbruger hedder dog, at hvis varen er i pæn stand, så har du ret til at sende det retur, hvis ikke producenten har tydeligt oplyst andet. Et godt eksempel kunne være den kendte ”Bryd ikke”-mærket som tydeligt oplyser, at hvis du ønsker at returnere varen, så skal du ikke bryde dette mærke.
## Hvad må komme i emballage?
Der findes emballage til alle tænkelige emner, hvorfor der ikke er en hovedregel for hvad der må komme i emballagen. Når det kommer til transportemballage, så bør man i første omgang betragte emnes vægt og skrøbelighed. Der findes emballage som varetager et hvert behov, så kunsten er faktisk, at undgå at overemballere, da dette er stor spild, som vi desværre ofte ser i produktionsbranchen. Vi anbefaler altid, at du tager kontakt til din emballageleverandør, hvis du er i tvivl om hvad der må komme i emballagen.
## Hvilken emballage er mest miljøvenlig?
Der findes stort set ingen emballage som er 100% miljøvenlig, men der findes 3 typer emballage som bestræber sig på at være miljøvenlig, og disse er emballager med materiale reduktion, emballager af genbrugsmateriale og biobaseret emballage. Et eksempel kan være papkasser af genbrugspap, tynd strækfilm og biofyld af f.eks. ålegræs. Det skal dog siges, at til det formål at gøre sin emballageproces mere bæredygtig, så er det vigtigere at kigge på processerne og ikke nødvendigvis materialet.
## Kontakt os gerne med spørgsmål om emballage
Selvom vores udbud af emballage er stort og omfattende, så kan det ske, at du alligevel står og mangler noget, som vi ikke har på lager. Det betyder dog ikke, at vi ikke kan hjælpe alligevel. Kontakt os gerne via telefon eller på mail, så finder vi sammen frem til den perfekte løsning på netop din udfordring.
Som totalleverandør indenfor emballage står vi altid til rådighed, hvis du har spørgsmål angående vores sortiment eller din ordre. Hos os er det muligt at samle alle emballagekøb ét sted, hvilket betyder færre procesomkostninger og mere tid til vigtigere arbejdsopgaver. Hvis du ønsker at se nogle af vores produkter, inden du køber stort ind, så tilbyder vi hele tre gratis vareprøver pr. ordre. På den måde har vores kunder mulighed for at afprøve vores emballageprodukter og se, om de dækker både behov og ønsker.
Vores omkostningsniveau ligger under andre totalleverandører i branchen, hvilket betyder, at vores kunder får god kvalitet, høj service og konkurrencedygtige priser uden skjulte gebyrer eller tillæg. Vores førsteprioritet er altid tilfredse kunder, og derfor svarer vi altid hurtigst muligt på alle henvendelser, vi får.
Vi glæder os til at hjælpe dig og din virksomhed med god og beskyttende emballage.

# **Discover the Best Cosmetics Products Online: A Guide to Buying Halal Makeup and Beauty Essentials**
Purchasing cosmetics online is undoubtedly our modern approach to beauty buying. The online availability of innumerable beauty products makes finding the best beauty stuff, which is suit your taste and needs, easier than ever before. Online beauty store contain everything from trying on new makeup fads to basic items such as lipstick.
Halal makeup and halal cosmetics are among the most prominent advantages of purchasing beauty items online. These products guarantee that your beauty regimen reflects your ethical and religious views while yet giving the same effectiveness and elegance as traditional makeup. From skincare to makeup, cosmetics online shopping allows you to browse and buy goods that match your individual needs, all from the comfort of your own home.
## Iba Cosmetics’ uniqueness as a brand
Like any other brands in the market Iba also offers cosmetic products online but what makes us, as a brand different from other beauty brands is that all the products from Iba are free from alcohol, pig fat, any type of animal derived ingredients, harsh and dangerous chemicals like sulphates, parabens, ammonia, and bleaching agents.
Unlike other cosmetics brands we do not use ingredients like carmine (crushed beetle bugs which give the red pigment in lipsticks), pig fat, beeswax, and so on. These ingredients are not only harmful for your skin and body but also considered as ‘haram’. Applying lipstick involves the risk of ingesting a certain amount while talking, eating, or drinking, making the presence of such ingredients uncomfortable and undesirable.
## **Why Shop for Cosmetics Products Online?**
Online shopping is a popular option for many people since it provides a number of advantages. Online shopping is the best option for the following reasons:
**Convenience**: You can easily shop whenever you want and get what you want without the hassle of going to a brick-and-mortar store far from your home. You can get your favorite makeup products from home or on the go with just a few clicks. **Broad Selection**: Compared to conventional locations, online cosmetics retailers provide a far greater range of items. To fit your tastes, you can investigate a wide variety of brands, product kinds, and formulas.
**Product Details:** Online purchasing makes it simple to read reviews, compare items, and learn about the components, advantages, and application techniques. This enables you to choose your cosmetics product with knowledge.
**Easy Delivery**: Beauty products online shopping allows for convenient delivery options, ensuring your cosmetics products arrive at your doorstep. Online shopping is made even more alluring by the fact that many cosmetics retailers provide exclusive discounts, offers, and promotions on their merchandise.
**Pro Tip:** Use our exclusive **Iba Cosmetics coupon code** to enjoy special discounts on your favorite halal beauty products. Get **10% off** your first purchase and shop ethically, affordably, and confidently!
## **The Best Beauty Products Online: Halal Cosmetics and More**
The most important thing to keep in mind while buying cosmetics from an online site is whether the products align with your ideals. Cosmetics created exclusively in compliance with the Islamic law are said to be halal cosmetics, as these do not contain any harmful or forbidden elements at any point. Also, this kind of products offers great options for ethical shoppers as these are derived components from humane origins and cruelty free in making.
Our specialty at Iba Cosmetics is providing premium halal cosmetics that complies with the strictest ethical guidelines and is safe for your skin. You can be sure that Iba Cosmetics offers only the greatest skincare, makeup, and foundation products for your beauty regimen.
When it comes to our brand, there are makeup and skincare options for everyone. In the category of makeup, our brand offers every single makeup item you will ever need to create a complete look for any occasion and also for daily wear.
## M **ust-Have Products from Online Cosmetics Store**
### Long Stay Matte Lipstick
For a flawless pout that lasts you an entire day, there is Iba Cosmetics' **Long Stay Lipstick**. This lipstick comes in a variety of tints, not only guarantees glossy, bright lips but also provides every other thing that you would expect from a long-lasting, very well long stay lipstick. This lovely lipstick must be in your beauty kit because it suits every condition.
### Liquid Foundation
It is really necessary to have a good foundation for your complexion to be very even and flawless. Iba Cosmetics have a range of different **liquid foundation** solutions that match for looking natural as well as giving great coverage. Foundation suits everyone - for every skin tone and type, either matt or dewy.
### Lip Mask

### Borusan Grubu
Borusan Grubu’nun temel stratejisi, Türkiye ekonomisine katma değer yaratmaya devam ederken, yenilikçi ürün ve hizmetler geliştirmeye odaklı, ufku dünya pazarlarına açık bir vizyon üzerine kurulu.
2024 yılında 80. kuruluş yıldönümünü kutlayan Borusan Grubu, başta Türkiye olmak üzere dünyanın farklı pazarlarında üretim, makine ve güç sistemleri, otomotiv, lojistik ve enerji sektörlerinde istikrarlı büyümesini sürdürüyor.

Borusan Boru, Borçelik ve Supsan şirketleriyle çelik boru, galvanizli çelik ve supap sektöründe Türkiye’nin, Avrupa’nın ve dünyanın önde gelen üreticilerinden.

Borusan Cat, 'Daha İyi Bir Dünya İçin Çözüm Üretiriz’ şirket amacıyla inşaat, madencilik, enerji ve ulaşım endüstrilerinde faaliyet gösterir. Dünyanın önde gelen jeneratör markalarından FG Wilson’ın Türkiye ve Kuzey Irak distribütörlüğünü yürütür.

Borusan Otomotiv Grubu; Borusan Otomotiv İthalat, Borusan Otomotiv Pazarlama, Borusan Oto, Borusan Oto Kıbrıs, Borusan Otomotiv Premium, BOM Motor Sporları ve Borusan Oto Değerlendirme olarak 7 şirketiyle premium otomobil ve motosiklet segmentinde faaliyet göstermektedir. Borusan Liman Hizmetleri olarak Liman, Proje ve Ağır Taşımacılık, Gemi Kiralama ve Proje Taşımacılığı olmak üzere üç ana iş biriminde faaliyet gösteriyor, bu entegre yapı sayesinde müşterilerimize bütünsel lojistik çözümler sunuyoruz. **The first, most comprehensive “all-in-one” solution on the market**. Ideal for mixed crop and livestock farming and working with your partners, all within the same software:
-Managing cattle, sheep, goat and poultry farms,

Wherever you are and regardless of network coverage, BAOBA works **online and off-line**.
Thanks to **multi-user** synchronisation, share information in **real time**.

Aluminium foil packaging provides a resistant barrier to safeguard food, beverage, cosmetics, and pharmaceuticals while helping reduce waste. **BOPA Films**
High barrier Bi-Oriented Polyamide (BOPA) film used mainly in vacuum packaging and vacuum retort packaging. BOPA films offer excellent oxygen barrier, mechanical protection, and chemical resistance, making them ideal for processed meats, seafood, frozen products, dairy, and pharmaceutical applications.

Biaxially-Oriented Polyethylene Terephthalate (BOPET) films are made of polyethylene terephthalate by casting into film and further stretching it into the machine and cross directions. ## Solar Industry
The **solar industry** experts in **contaminants removal** agents and **soiling mitigation** and **performance enhancement** products.
## Challenges & Limitations in Solar Panel Maintenance
**Solar panel maintenance often faces key challenges:**
- **Soiling & Dirt Accumulation:** Dust, bird droppings, and other contaminants reduce light transmission, impacting panel performance.
- **Environmental Concerns:** Cleaning agents must be biodegradable and eco-friendly to protect both the panels and the environment.
- **Compatibility with PV Modules:** Products should not interfere with the panel’s lifespan, particularly the anti-reflective coatings (ARC).
- **Cleaning Restrictions:** Panels should be cleaned during cooler periods (e.g., cloudy days or early/late hours) and without abrasive tools or high-pressure equipment.

PreZero verfolgte mit diesem Projekt das Ziel, eine geografische Versorgungslücke zu schließen. Kürzere Transportwege, geringere Emissionen und eine effizientere Abfallwirtschaft sollen dazu beitragen, Österreichs Nachhaltigkeitsziele zu erreichen.
Die Umsetzung des Projekts erforderte umfassendes technisches Fachwissen und eine präzise Koordination über mehrere Teams und Projektphasen hinweg. Da zahlreiche Gewerke gleichzeitig tätig waren und die Montage bereits begann, bevor der Bau der Hallen abgeschlossen war, war die Ausführung außerordentlich komplex.
Die Fähigkeit von STADLER, diese anspruchsvollen Rahmenbedingungen erfolgreich zu bewältigen, war entscheidend für die termingerechte Fertigstellung der schlüsselfertigen Anlage. Die vollautomatisierte Anlage passt sich dynamisch an wechselnde Materialzusammensetzungen an. Sie setzt neue Maßstäbe in den Bereichen Automatisierung, Sicherheit und Leistung und ist zugleich die bislang größte und komplexeste von STADLER realisierte Anlage.

## Viant Company FAQs
### What does Viant do as a medical device contract manufacturing company?
Viant is a medical device contract manufacturer providing end-to-end contract manufacturing for medical devices—from design and development through precision manufacturing, sterile and non-sterile device assembly. OEMs and MedTech startups partner with Viant as a single-source manufacturer of medical devices or engage specific capabilities as needed.
### What makes Viant different from other medical device contract manufacturers?
A vertically integrated model with global manufacturing facilities is what differentiates Viant from many medical device contract manufacturers. With ViaLaunch™ program management, engineering support, and quality management systems across its footprint, device manufacturers can move from development into production with stronger risk mitigation, process validation, and scalable production volume.
### What capabilities does Viant offer for contract manufacturing for medical devices?
A broad set of contract manufacturing services across the device lifecycle: program management, medical device engineering support, materials expertise, metals (including metal tubing), extrusions, medical‑grade plastics (including micro‑molding), tooling, automation capabilities, device assembly, and finished device services. Viant combines these capabilities within a vertically integrated manufacturing network.
### What clinical markets does Viant support?
Viant supports a range of clinical device applications, including Orthopedics, Surgical Technologies, Cardiac & Interventional, Drug Delivery, Bioprocessing, Bioelectronics, Diagnostics & Laboratory Products, and Respiratory, Monitoring & Patient Care.
### How large is Viant’s manufacturing footprint?
A global manufacturing footprint of 26 locations, 2.3M square feet of manufacturing space, and 300K+ square feet of cleanroom space. With Viant, device manufacturers can leverage regional production options and scalable capacity across programs.

So far Jesse has managed to record four albums, but that’s just a start! He’s still in the prime of his career, and it would seem as though nothing is slowing him down.
Over the years he has played countless live shows; ranging from music festivals and parties to selling out venues. He has honed his skill as a performer and audiences always leave with a smile on their faces. Jesse is known to give 150% to every performance!
After years with the Jesse Jordan Band, Jesse has started a new solo journey. It’s just him, a guitar and his life experiences. He has spent the last two years writing new songs which explore the lessons he’s learned on his journey.
This new solo project is all about story-telling in the style of old-school singer-songwriters and bluesmen. It’s raw, personal and real. In his music, you will find a hint of Michael Buble meets Maroon5, but the sound is still unmistakably Jesse Jordan.
#### **Faith Endorsement**
In September 2017 Jesse Jordan was officially endorsed by Faith Guitars and Paul Bothner Music.
Faith guitars all have a rich and unique tone which perfectly matches the rawness of Jesse’s stories. It is a perfect partnership of tone and perfection.
To keep up with Jesse, go to his Facebook page or website and give him a like and a listen.
CCFM (Cape Community FM) is a 24-hour, non-profit, community radio station serving the people of Cape Town. We play a mix of contemporary Christian music, combined with compelling chat, views and interviews. Not to mention up-to-the-minute news, weather and traffic information. CCFM was the first community radio station and has been on the airwaves for over 18 years, starting as Radio Fish Hoek in 1993. We currently broadcast from our building in Muizenberg on 107.5 FM in the Greater Cape Town and on 96.7 FM in the Fish Hoek valley.
Tunes is a rehearsal studio that acts in the interest of local music by providing affordable practice space, good quality reference rehearsal recordings, drum lessons and retailing in musical accessories including guitar strings, drumsticks and larger items that can be ordered from Paul Bothner. We recently added new items to our stock such as drum skins, cymbals, guitar and bass pedals. We also stock electric, acoustic and bass guitars.
Tunes is open for bookings seven days a week from 08h00 to 24h00. Bookings can be made by contacting Jean on 082 7704798 or by e-mail, tunesstudio@gmail.com
With studios in Cape Town & Johannesburg and branches in Lagos and Dar Es Salaam, Sound & Motion Studios is a multi-purpose audio solution covering both POST PRODUCTION AND MUSIC PRODUCTION. With a team of highly skilled engineers, producers and composers in our stable, our facilities offer analogue warmth and character, guaranteed through beautiful mixing consoles and tape machines, that forms the soul of music productions, as well as the digital accuracy and recall requirements for film, tv and corporate productions.
SoundHouse is a music educational vision. Designed not only to educate microcosmically but to facilitate the teaching of musical concepts through music technology. A particular focus of this vision is on music experimentation, composition, learning and recording, digital media, such as picture stories, music videos and digital mash-ups.
Talented singer/songwriter Louise Day has been captivating audiences and stealing hearts since a young age. A true Cape Town girl through and through, her unique blend of Folk/Pop, delivered by her outstanding lingering vocals, have been showcased at some of the trendiest and musically influential venues in South Africa.
Her music career started professionally when an itch to explore the international music scene lead her to the United States where she settled for a year in Colorado. There she began performing at a premiere live music venue, “Bellyup” (www.bellyupaspen.com), regularly opening for visiting internationally recognized artists, including the likes of the acclaimed ‘Grace Potter & The Nocturnals’ and ‘The English Beat’. q
This exposure resulted in a tremendous demand for her talents, and her remaining time was spent performing as a Fender Musician at the Winter X Games and Tempe Music Festival in Arizona, performing on the same stage as many international artists such as John Mayer and The Fray. She also made her mark on Fender USA when she was approached to endorse their new range of guitars for women. Since her return to South Africa, Louise and her band launched their very successful debut album “Chasing the Wind “ followed by a second album “Swallowed by the City” which was produced by music legend Theo Crous of the Springbok Nude Girls.
The album went on to receive a SAMA (South African Music Awards) nomination for best Pop Album. After a busy time of live performances, Louise and her band are back in the studio working on their third album which will be released in 2014.
Follow Louise on Facebook or check out her website.
Lance has what people in the drumming community call Gospel Chops. This is a combination of intense technical playing and drum patterns which have big funk and hip hop swinging grooves. He is currently one of the top Gospel Chops drummers in Cape Town and is already counted as one of the top drummers in South Africa.He runs his own music school where he works with and teaches young children to play music.
He’s been teaching around Cape Town and its surrounds. Lance studied at Cape Music Institute where he played in the Camillo Lombard Trio and Donveno Prins Band for 2 years. Since then, Lance has been a session musician and has worked with top artists like Camillo Lombard, Donveno Prins, Loyiso Bala, Allou April, Joyous Celebration, Ernie Smith, Sammy Webber, and One Accord.He has two drumming instructional DVDs: “Playing over the Groove” and “Beyond Playing”.
For bookings contact Mark on 083 3130 233 or Beryl on 073 0122 870
Beau Soleil offers tuition on all the instruments of the orchestra, namely flute, oboe, clarinet, saxophone, bassoon, violin, viola, cello, double bass, trumpet, trombone, French horn, euphonium, tuba and percussion. An Open Evening is held once a year, during which most of the instruments are demonstrated and prospective pupils and parents have an opportunity to learn more about Beau Soleil. A number of these instruments are available for hire for a limited period.
The Gryphon Music Academy is a guitar school based in Plumstead, Cape Town. We offer guitar lessons, bass lessons, song writing courses and music theory courses Our Motto is “Turning players into musicians”. At the Gryphon Music Academy we believe in teaching players of all levels to not just play the instrument, but to think about the entire scope of the instrument in the context of music. Besides learning the practical side of playing, you will also learn music theory, song writing and instrument maintenance.
Rockschool is the leading accredited provider of rock & pop exams worldwide. We offer Graded Music Exams in the principal rock instruments and Diplomas in Teaching and Performance. Rockschool produces and examines unique music qualifications that are taught by independent teachers in schools, colleges and music centres all over the world. Rockschool music qualifications are practical, flexible and fun and are open to musicians of all ages and abilities.
Offering lessons in:
Vocal, Guitar, Piano, Drums, Bass Guitar, Violin, Cello, Saxophone, Oboe, Clarient, & Flute, and with lessons available in Bryanston, Fourways, Centurion and Kemptopn Park, the Global House of Music is your one stop music lesson option in the Joberg area. They even offer home lessons. Check out there website to make a booking or call them directly on: 083 959 3782
A high energy electronicore band focused on bombastic theatrical performances, Set For The Sky have been making waves all across the local scene with electric live performances and a high quality sound. Consummate professionals, they have been gigging since 2013 and have continued to grow their name in the South African music market, with a highly acclaimed debut album, “The Machine”, released in 2015 and two video singles “Live Like You’re on Fire” and “The Secret Season”.
They have played numerous shows around the country including slots on many festivals and tours, they do not settle for mediocre, whether in their performance or their music, and will continue to provide an exceptional experience for their fans.
BULLETSCRIPT is a band with a clear message – open your eyes to the world around you, and question everything, taking nothing, and nobody, for granted.
The band consists of a full compliment of seasoned performers from the Cape Town metal scene. A band that enjoys pushing the envelope, placing great emphasis on solid song writing, stellar stage performance and a delivery so intense that your neck will be in a constant state of headbanging ecstasy.
Combining the skills of Ian Watson (Vocals), Jacques Hugo (Guitar), Oliver Saggerson (Guitar), JJ du Toit (Bass) and Kyle Curran (Drums), BULLETSCRIPT is ready to spread the word, take no prisoners and have a great time!
Follow the band on Facebook
The Mercury is a top class music venue in Cape Town, right up the road from the Cape Technikon and close to the city itself. Incorporating two venues playing a large mix of music, it is one of the best places in Cape Town to hear South African tunes.
This venue is actually two in one: the Live and the Lounge areas. With its own in-house sound and lighting system, the Mercury has built a superb reputation and a loyal clientele during its 10-year existence.
Located in the old historic area of District Six, also known as Zonnebloem, it hosts live music entertainment ranging in style from rock, hip-hop and pop to jazz, world music and electronica.
Mercury’s upstairs Live venue has a capacity of over 600, and has seen most of South Africa’s top acts perform on its stage. Foosball and pool tables provide a diversion in between performances. With regular specials and promotions on offer, it’s a firm favourite with live music aficionados.
The smaller, downstairs Lounge venue has capacity for approximately 150 people, and hosts DJ parties and student nights on certain evenings. Staying open till the wee hours, the lounge is also a favourite late-night dancing and chill-out spot for patrons from other clubbing venues nearby.
Owned by former band and road manager Kevin Winder, the Mercury has a solid reputation for providing the best quality sound in a convenient and well-equipped venue. This ethos extends to making sure that only the best bands, both established and up-and-coming, are invited to play, resulting in top quality music nights.
The venue has a relaxed and friendly vibe, with good security and, a rarity amongst live music venues, excellent service. Dedicated to supporting South African music, it’s one of the best live music venues in the country.
NueLight Productions is the brainchild and passion of Julita Kok. NueLight produces superb musical showcases bringing the very best of South African talent to the fore. Producer of showcases such as ‘Christmas with GOD TV’, Blue Rock Gospel Fest, BAHI Healing Concert and many others, NueLight is definitely making its mark on the international and local Christian Music Industry. Entrepreneur, producer, events coordinator and artist developer, Julita Kok, an accomplished vocalist herself, has made excellence a priority for NueLight, its artists and productions. Maintaining this high calibre by associating with the crème dela crème of the Christian Music Industry.
In De Kuilen street Kuilsriver, the average passer-by may be pleasantly surprised by what is heard when passing number 15. This building houses a premier music school within the community: Cape Music Institute. The sounds of guitar, bass-guitar, drums, keyboards, saxophones, and voices fill the air, making it an educational, entertaining and fun atmosphere. The concept of Cape Music Institute was birthed during a meeting in 2005 between Camillo Lombard, Ezra Delport, and Gary Thomas and, is currently in its fourth year of existence. Each individual contributed his own vision and ideas of what the school should be and, the outcome was a combined vision of a higher education school of music, emphasized in three categories: performance, production and business. The “seed” for Cape Music Institute, however, had been “planted” in the three Founders independently.

Do you have a desire to play the drums or improve your guitar skills or another band instrument? If so, then M&M is the perfect part-time Music Academy for you. We have students that attend the academy from the Parklands, Table View, West Beach, Melkbos and Milnerton area. We offer musical training in all the popular band instruments from beginner to advanced. Why don’t you visit the “Instrument” tab to learn more about our drum, guitar, bass, piano/keyboard or vocal courses. We also offer a full digital recording studio operating on Cubase, Presonus, Rode and Alesis equipment, should you wish to lay some music tracks or follow your personal development at M&M.
COPA currently has four campuses around South Africa. Read about each of them below: Cape Town COPA’s Cape Town campus boasts the largest Live Performance Venue of all campuses. Facilities include rehearsal rooms, a demo room (production suite), a resource centre and a recording studio also hosting an Apple Mac equipped technology room. Johannesburg COPA’s Johannesburg campus is the largest of all campuses with over 300 students. Facilities include a resource centre, rehearsal rooms, demo rooms (production suites), an Apple Mac equipped technology room, recording studio and a Live Performance Venue. Pretoria COPA’s Pretoria campus is very centrally located. Facilities include a resource centre, rehearsal rooms, demo rooms (production suites), a recording studio also hosting an Apple Mac equipped technology room and a Live Performance Venue. Kwa-Zulu Natal (KZN) COPA’s KZN campus is the newest campus. Facilities include a resource centre, rehearsal rooms, a demo room (production suite), a recording studio and a Live Performance Venue.
The Athlone Academy of Music (AAM) is a non-profit organisation established in 1994 with the sole aim of providing music tuition within the Athlone area. This initiative has now expanded and has grown to include the greater Athlone community residing along the Klipfontein corridor including Langa, Gugulethu, Khayelitsha, Mitchells Plain, Retreat, Steenberg, Atlantis and Malmesbury to name but a few. The communities in and around Athlone have tried but there has not always been a cohesive attempt to make sure that music education is not lost to our children. Music tuition has shown to help with discipline, motivation and a sense of belonging. Three basic values that children from the poorer disadvantaged communities need plenty of. We all know that these communities suffer under the scourge of substance abuse, disease, abuse against women and children and a general decay of the social fibre in society. This social decay is largely a result of unemployment, poverty and idleness. We at the Academy feel obliged to create opportunities for children in the communities we serve to be active in music education and in so doing, eradicate some of the social pathologies we are faced with on a daily basis.
Music is about way more than solo acts. School of Rock Claremont is as focused on community, teamwork, and friendships as it is on inspiring awesome music. Through our performance-based approach, we foster an inclusive community of rockers in Claremont to build a unique type of confidence only gained through cool, real life experiences. Whether we’re in serious shredding-mode or just jamming along with the band, our team spurs the growth of real, practical skills for music-minded students.
At School of Rock Claremont, we believe everyone deserves to have fun and feel like a rock star. Visit us and get a feel for the awesome opportunities your child has waiting just around the corner.
For some people, music is all about technical mastery and learning songs written by various composers. But most musicians want to perfect the instrument in a way that allows them to express themselves through song.
There is a misconception among many people that unless you’re a natural-born songwriter, you’ll never really be any good at it. This is, of course, simply not true.
If you want to be a songwriter, you only need to do two things.
1) Learn the fundamentals of music theory and the rules of writing songs.
2) Practice. Remember that the first few hundred songs you write won’t be “the best” songs ever, but that’s why you need to keep working on it.
We can’t help you much with the second point, but if you want to learn the fundamentals of songwriting, then you should consider enrolling in the Cape Town School of Songwriting.
For more information, please contact Elaine Ridgway (082 7773133) or email clive@songwriters.co.za

###### about us
## Drizit Environmental is South Africa’s most established pollution control company
Delivering reliable, compliant, and effective environmental solutions since 1975. With nearly five decades of hands-on experience, we have built a reputation for rapid response, technical expertise, and unwavering commitment to environmental protection.
From emergency spill response to long-term environmental rehabilitation, we provide end-to-end pollution control solutions across South Africa and internationally, including Africa, the Middle East, and Europe.
Pollution control solutions
pollution control company
## Comprehensive Pollution Control Services
Drizit is far more than a spill response contractor. We offer a full spectrum of pollution control services, products, and compliance solutions designed to support operations before, during, and after environmental incidents.
## Our Core Offerings
## 24/7 Emergency Spill Response
Immediate, nationwide response to oil, chemical, fuel, and hazardous material spills on land, in ports, and in marine environments.
View Service
## Specialised Industrial Cleaning
High-risk and specialist cleaning services for industrial plants, tanks, pipelines, refineries, and contaminated industrial facilities.
View Service
## Spill Kits, Absorbents, and Degreasers
A complete range of compliant spill kits, absorbent products, degreasers, and response equipment tailored to site-specific risks.
View Service
## Oil/Water and Skimmer Separators
Design, supply, and ongoing support of separation systems to manage hydrocarbons, effluents, and contaminated water.
View Service
## Bioremediation and Rehabilitation
Environmentally responsible remediation and rehabilitation of contaminated soil, water, and sites using proven biological processes
View Service
## Waste Collection Solutions
Safe handling, transport, and compliant disposal of hazardous and non-hazardous waste in line with environmental legislation.
View Service
## Specialised Compliance Products
Pollution prevention, containment, and compliance solutions that help clients meet regulatory and ESG requirements.
View Service
Our Products
## What Sets Drizit Apart
### Experience That Can’t Be Replicated
With 50 years of pollution control experience, Drizit has successfully managed virtually every environmental incident and industrial challenge.
### Extensive Approved Vendor Network
We hold over 500 vendor numbers across major industries, continuously expanding our approved supplier and service-provider footprint.
### Trusted by Industry Leaders
Our long-standing client relationships span mining, oil and gas, chemical manufacturing, logistics, ports, and heavy industry, organisations that demand proven performance and compliance.
### Skilled, Diverse People
Our teams bring a broad, multi-disciplinary skillset, combining decades of field experience with technical, environmental, and safety expertise.
### Accredited, Certified, and Compliant
Drizit operates to the highest standards of health, safety, environment, and quality (HSEQ) compliance, ensuring safety, quality, and environmental responsibility.
### Proudly South African
We are a Level 1 BBBEE contributor, committed to transformation, local expertise, and sustainable growth.
More About Drizit
## Our Purpose is simple but powerful
Drizit strives to protect people, preserve the environment, safeguard property, and secure the future.

# Hi-Technology Group - ISO 13485 & JOSCAR Certified Injection Moulding Company
## Full-Service Contract Manufacturing
Hi-Technology Group is an ISO 13485 certified, JOSCAR registered plastic
injection moulding company with facilities in Waterlooville, Hampshire.
Named 3M EMEA Supplier of the Year, we manufacture plastic components and assemblies for medical, defence and safety-critical industries, including Chemring Countermeasures, Apollo Fire Detectors and Ocean Signal – with over 40 years of manufacturing experience.

As an award winning injection moulding company we fully understand how we can best serve you. This not only covers your full product requirements and where you are in the development path but also all the needs and services around this which will make you successful and give you an easier life.
From the product side we can support your design optimisation from a very early stage and partner you on the development and productionisation journey from tooling, process, assembly and testing design to full manufacturing. For services, we help with material selection, component and electronics sourcing, guidance on best practice processes, through to tool servicing, ultrasonic welding services, logistics and long-term service agreements. We also support joint customer cost reduction programmes to optimise costs long term. We offer much more than just injection moulding!

As one of the best plastic manufacturing companies in the UK we pride ourselves on being a full-service plastic injection moulding company committed to excellence at every stage of the manufacturing process.
